 World One Day International: Namibia vs Ireland Match Preview Odds & Predictions 
 Namibia 
 World One Day International 
 Today, 01:30 
 Windhoek, Nambia,
 High Performance Oval
 Ireland 
 Namibia will lock horns against Ireland in the World One Day International on Sunday. Namibia have won three of their last five games, while Ireland have lost three of their last five. The home team will win here. Below are previews, betting tips, and odds. 
 Namibia Preview 
 Namibia lost by 130 runs in their last game against Ireland, ending their two-game winning streak. The team hasn’t been in that bad a form recently. Although they failed to win in their last match, they have won three of their last five, including wins over USA by 6 wickets; their last two victories were over Ireland by 31 runs and 63 runs, and their two losses were against Ireland by 55 runs and in their last match by 130 runs. 
 Namibia XI 
 Malan Kruger, Louren Steenkamp, Jan Frylinck, Gerhard Erasmus (c), Jan Nicol Loftie-Eaton, Alexander Busing-Volschenk, Zane Green (wk), Jonathan Smit, Ruben Trumpelmann, Bernard Scholtz, Jack Brassell. 
 Ireland Preview 
 Ireland won a 103-run in their last game against Namibia, ending their two-game losing streak. In this game, Ireland batted first and scored 298 runs, setting a huge target for their opponents. When it was time for their opponent, Namibia, to bat, they were bowled out for just 168 runs, giving Ireland a massive victory and winning by 103 runs. This team has lost three times and won twice in their last five games. 
 Ireland XI 
 Tim Tector, Andy Balbirnie, Cade Carmichael, Harry Tector, Curtis Campher, Lorcan Tucker (wk), George Dockrell, Andy McBrine, Gavin Hoey, Jai Moondra, Liam McCarthy. 
 Namibia vs Ireland Prediction 
 Namibia is the favorite to win here because they are in better form than Ireland in their last five games: Namibia have won three times, while Ireland have lost three. Not only that, Namibia have won three of the last five head-to-head games against Ireland. With that in mind, I backed the home team to win at all costs. My prediction is Namibia to win, with 1xBet offering odds of 2.31.
